tasks.instruction: Read AGENTS.md, MUSE.md and MUSE-54 only. Audit documentation bloat and stale startup instructions. Allowed output docs/qa/muse54-archive-audit.md only; no deletes, moves, code edits or queue edits. Identify at most 8 concrete archive candidates with inbound-reference checks and replacement pointers. Separate obsolete operational instructions from valuable mathematical/test evidence. Include a ready-to-apply relocation list and identify stale manual launch prompts. Do not read whole historical archives. Use file inventories and targeted searches. Report under 700 words. This docs-only audit needs no full test suite, browser or environment diagnosis. Stop after report; do not launch other agents.
